about: Naust Cove (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 03 and 05; Stage 14, decisions S14-1, S14-5, S14-21 and S14-37): blocks 24 to 35 by 24 to 31, south of the Hollow Cairn's ground and east of Wreck Strand, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. The cove's beach of shingle and sand at its north-east with landing N2 at block (32, 24); the boatshed plot pegged out on the turf west of the beach; the line of old stones in the turf leading west to the old naust, its fallen boat-hollow and its lintel cut with a ship; the flats bare at low water and under the sea at high; the fishing rocks on the cove's two points and the west rocks with the low-water pocket under them. Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
